finalText:
**A small JSON API in five files, no package.json, no tests.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server[server.js] --> auth[auth.js]
  server --> routes[routes.js]
  routes --> cache[cache.js]
  routes --> store[store.js]
  cache --> store
```

`server.js` takes the request, checks the token, hands off. `auth.js` signs and checks bearer tokens with a shared secret. `routes.js` maps method plus path to three handlers. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry LRU. Writes go straight to `store.js`, an in-memory map where records die after 15 minutes.

One thing to know: the comment in `routes.js` promises writes clear the cache, but `POST /orders` never does. A new order stays invisible until the LRU evicts that key.
